figures.caption: Overview of CurvTrust-PAI. A shared reference-anchored residual feeds two independently evaluated pathways, a network-flow detector and a swarm trust and safety filter; there is no run-time data exchange between them.
Per-dataset F1 of all seven configurations on the four public benchmarks (mean ± std over five seeds).
Per-method F1 on Custom-EdgeIoT (mean ± std over five seeds).
F1 against noise amplitude ε — average over the four public datasets.
F1 against noise amplitude ε — Custom-EdgeIoT.
Ablation of residual integration on the four public datasets: F1 of each classifier with and without the residual (mean ± std over five seeds).
Mean trust of honest and compromised agents during a run under the overt (left) and authenticated (right) attack.

Custom-EdgeIoT diagnostics. (a) F1 against the conformal level α; (b) data saturation; (c) learning curves; (d) mean residual and attack recall under clean, random and adaptive-suppression conditions; (e) method comparison on the worker split; (f) noise robustness.
Wall-clock time of one complete filter step (all agents) against swarm size N (mean ± std over ten repetitions).
